name: Tombs of Buganda Kings at Kasubi
description: On a hillside in Kampala, Uganda, the Kasubi Tombs hold the graves of four kings of Buganda inside a great circular, domed house built entirely from wood, thatch, reed and mud-plastered wattle. The site began as a royal palace in 1882 and became a burial ground in 1884. It remains a living spiritual centre for the Baganda. A 2010 fire destroyed the main building, and restoration has since brought it back.
